_comment: Recorded fixture for a 207 from POST /crm/v4/associations/tasks/contacts/batch/read. HubSpot answers 207 when some inputs had no associations, carrying results and errors together. Activity 201 links one contact; 202 has none and appears only as a NO_ASSOCIATIONS_FOUND error, which must land an explicit empty array rather than fail the run. Activity 203 is a real failure and must still raise.

errors.message: No associations were found for the provided object ids.
